name: ESP Home
description:
# ESP Home

ESPHome is a system to control your microcontrollers by simple yet powerful configuration files and control them remotely through Home Automation systems.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Username
questions.hint: Username of your ESP Home account

questions.label: Password
questions.hint: Password of your ESP Home account

questions.label: Use ping for devices availability ? (default to mDNS)
questions.hint: mDNS doesn't work across VLANs, use static IP for devices when disabling mDNS

compose:
services:
  esphome:
    image: ghcr.io/esphome/esphome:2026.10.1
    container_name: esphome
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
      - USERNAME=${ESPHOME_USERNAME:-''}
      - PASSWORD=${ESPHOME_PASSWORD:-''}
      - ESPHOME_DASHBOARD_USE_PING=${ESPHOME_PING:-'false'}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - ${APP_PORT}:6052
    volumes:
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/config:/config
